items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: we were in the pit like Johnny Hodges and Otto Hardwick and those guys.

ctx.x: And Bob Hope was on the stage and when he took his bow and got through -- this is funny -- the boys in the band started to laugh, and we were in the pit like Johnny Hodges and Otto Hardwick and those guys. Bob Hope seat of his pants had a hole in them, and we laughed like mad. This was Bob Hope.
